runtime.note: Shares the cooldown_indicator implementation (client/src/render/abilityBar.js). This fragment's three states map onto slotState(): 'uncharged' = cooling, 'charging' = the final 25% of the cooldown (accented warm so a cast can be timed without reading numbers), 'charged' = ready. Fill decays by local frame time between the 20 Hz emits so it moves at display rate.
